events.title: An apparent final response is followed by a real-file wake

limitations: Neither rollout reached its registered 90-minute wall-clock endpoint; both stopped on native context-compaction events. No restart or replacement.
Equal configured per-member budgets are not equal realized duration, tokens or number of interactions.
One descriptive pair, no causal intervention and no blinded second reviewer. Condition also bundles joint-task framing, roster and a message interface.
The common research.md output path and publication notices were supplied in both conditions. Organizational roles were not supplied, but the environment affords shared editing.
A successful scalar write is not a separate integration or role. Automatic path delivery is not a read; reading is not task adoption. Tool calls and model responses are not social interaction rounds.
Unintended has no recognized JSON messages but does have cross-agent artifact communication. Absence of a verified delegation chain is not proof that none can emerge.
All sixteen native session exports and collected evidence were retained. ATIF validation failed after context compaction; the fallback inventory is not collector actor-evidence certification.
Mathematical statements remain agent-generated conditional progress, with gaps and corrections. No global regularity proof, novelty claim or independent mathematical certification.
